decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
That details of Soft and Hard Landscaping as shown on plans 1963-PP-01 Rev D and plans 0531WD002.1 Rev A and 2.2 Rev.A , pursuant to condition 9 of approval, ref 00798/101/P7 the erection of part three- part four-storey blocks comprising 30 one, two and three-bedroom flats and 2 x  three-bedroom houses with associated parking and hard and soft landscaping, dated  9 October 2006, received 25  February 2008 be approved.
description: Following approval for erection of 4 part 4,3 and 2 storey blocks comprising 30 one, two and three bed flats and 2 x 3 bed houses with associated parking and hard and soft lanscaping, details submitted pursuant to Condition 9 (Hard and Soft Landscaping) of approved planning reference 00798/101/P7 dated 09/10/06
